title: The Toll of the Seven Gates
text: Seven gates stand open in the hillside, each lower than the last, each colder. At the seventh, a crowned god of plague sits among the dead, and the dead do not seem to mind. He offers you health against every sickness the world holds, for a toll.

options.label: Kneel among the dead, and pay his toll.

outcomes.text: The fevers of the world will pass you by. The god keeps a Year of each of you, folded up somewhere below.

options.label: Refuse him, here at the seventh gate.

outcomes.text: He rises from his throne of the dead, and he is very much larger standing.

options.label: Take his blessing, and leave the bowl empty.

outcomes.text: The leader takes the blessing and spits in the toll bowl. The god stands, smiling.
The toll takes itself, quietly, from each of you. The god stands anyway, and his dead stand with him.
